result.instructions: Tools for Simple Inventory, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which items are low on stock, and how many do we have left?"; "Take 3 blue mugs out of stock for order 1042."; "Show the folders in our warehouse and how many items each holds.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Simple Inventory data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run simpleinventory_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run simpleinventory_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run simpleinventory_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. simpleinventory_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: simpleinventory_get_account
tools.title: Get the connected account
tools.description: Show the organization and API key this server uses, with the key's scopes (read, write). Good first call to check the connection. Simple Inventory API: GET /me.

tools.name: simpleinventory_list_folders
tools.title: List folders
tools.description: List the organization's folders with their IDs and full paths. Use a folder ID as folderId when you create or move an item. Simple Inventory API: GET /folders.

tools.name: simpleinventory_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: List active (not archived) items with quantity, prices, SKU and folder. Search by name or SKU with search, or find one SKU with sku. To read every item, pass after=0 and then each response's pagination.nextAfter until hasMore is false. Simple Inventory API: GET /items.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Ignored when after is set.

after.description: Return items with an ID greater than this, lowest first. Start with 0. Use instead of offset to read all items.

include.description: "leaves" (default): standalone items and variations. "groups": items and variant groups. "all": both.

sku.description: Return only the item with this SKU (only with offset 0).

search.description: Items whose name or SKU contains this text (not case-sensitive).

tools.name: simpleinventory_get_item
tools.title: Get an item
tools.description: Get one item by ID or SKU, including archived items (archived: true). A variant group also returns its variations. Simple Inventory API: GET /items/{identifier}.

identifier.description: The item's numeric ID or its SKU (from simpleinventory_list_items). Archived items are found too.

by.description: How to read identifier: "auto" (default), "id", or "sku". Use "sku" when SKUs are numbers.

tools.name: simpleinventory_list_recent_events
tools.title: List recent events
tools.description: List the newest events of one type (stock changes, low or out-of-stock alerts, item created, updated or archived), newest first. Useful to test a webhook handler with real data. Simple Inventory API: GET /events.

type.description: The event type, such as inventory.updated.

tools.name: simpleinventory_create_item
tools.title: Create an item
tools.description: Create a standalone item, as adding it in the app would. It counts toward the plan's item limit and needs an organization that is not past due. Simple Inventory API: POST /items.

sku.description: SKU (up to 100 characters). Must not match another item's SKU.

lowStockThreshold.description: Stock level that counts as low.

tools.name: simpleinventory_update_item
tools.title: Update an item's details
tools.description: Change an item's details (not its stock). Send only the fields to change. null clears a field, except name. Archived items cannot be changed. Simple Inventory API: PATCH /items/{identifier}.

identifier.description: The item's numeric ID or its SKU (from simpleinventory_list_items). Archived items are found too.

by.description: How to read identifier: "auto" (default), "id", or "sku". Use "sku" when SKUs are numbers.

sku.description: New SKU, or null to clear it.

unitCost.description: New unit cost (null sets it to 0).

salePrice.description: New sale price, or null to clear it.

lowStockThreshold.description: New low stock level, or null to clear it.

description.description: New description, or null to clear it.

barcode.description: New barcode, or null to clear it.

folderId.description: Move to this folder, or null to unfile it.

tools.name: simpleinventory_change_stock
tools.title: Change an item's stock
tools.description: Set, add to, or remove from one item's stock. operation "set" (default) makes stock exactly quantity; "increment" adds; "decrement" removes and stops at 0. Pass idempotencyKey so a retry cannot apply twice. Simple Inventory API: PATCH /items/{identifier}/quantity.

identifier.description: The item's numeric ID or its SKU (from simpleinventory_list_items). Archived items are found too.

by.description: How to read identifier: "auto" (default), "id", or "sku". Use "sku" when SKUs are numbers.

quantity.description: The amount, 0 to 1,000,000,000. Stock cannot exceed 2,147,483,647.

reason.description: Note saved on the item's history entry.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional key so a retry cannot apply the same change twice (up to 255 characters). Use one new key per change.

tools.name: simpleinventory_bulk_update_stock
tools.title: Change stock on many items
tools.description: Change stock on 1-100 items in one request. Give each change an id or a sku. Each change applies on its own, so one failure does not stop the rest. A 200 reply can still list failed changes in errors: check success and errors. Simple Inventory API: POST /items/bulk-update.

id.description: Item ID. Give id or sku.

sku.description: Item SKU. Give id or sku.

reason.description: Note saved on the item's history entry.

items.description: The stock changes, applied in order.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional key for the whole request. Change i is recorded as <key>:<i>, so resend the same list in the same order.

tools.name: simpleinventory_subscribe_webhook
tools.title: Subscribe a URL to an event
tools.description: Send one event type to a URL you own, as a signed HTTP POST (HMAC-SHA256). The reply returns the signing secret only in the app (Settings → Integrations → Webhooks). Subscribing twice returns the existing subscription. Limit 50 API subscriptions per organization. Simple Inventory API: POST /hooks.

targetUrl.description: The HTTPS URL that receives the events.

event.description: The one event type to deliver.

annotations.title: Subscribe a URL to an event

tools.name: simpleinventory_unsubscribe_webhook
tools.title: Remove an API subscription
tools.description: Remove a subscription made with simpleinventory_subscribe_webhook, with its delivery log. Webhooks added in the app are not removed here. Simple Inventory API: DELETE /hooks/{id}.

id.description: The subscription ID returned by simpleinventory_subscribe_webhook.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Simple Inventory
prompts.description: What you can do with Simple Inventory here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_items_that_are_low_on_stock
prompts.title: Find items that are low on stock
prompts.description: List the active items with their quantities. Check the recent low and out-of-stock events to see which items run out first.

prompts.name: browse_folders_and_the_items_in_them
prompts.title: Browse folders and the items in them
prompts.description: List the folders with their IDs and full paths. Then list the items to see the folder of each one.

prompts.name: look_up_one_item_by_id_or_sku
prompts.title: Look up one item by ID or SKU
prompts.description: Get one item by its ID or SKU, archived items included. For a variant group, read its variations too.

prompts.name: take_units_out_of_stock_for_an_order
prompts.title: Take units out of stock for an order
prompts.description: Remove units from one item's stock for an order. Pass an idempotency key, so a retry cannot remove the units twice.

prompts.name: update_stock_for_many_items_at_once
prompts.title: Update stock for many items at once
prompts.description: Change the stock of up to 100 items in one request, for example after a physical count. The reply lists any failed changes.

prompts.name: send_inventory_events_to_an_order_system
prompts.title: Send inventory events to an order system
prompts.description: Subscribe a URL you own to one event type. Read the recent events to test your handler with real data.
